name: package_code
description: Primary Key: Cruise Voyage Code or Holiday Package Code (e.g., B629C, FAM-TOR-402, CRU-IONA-510).

name: holiday_type
description: Category: Cruise & Stay, Family Beach, Accessible Cruise, Family Luxury Beach, Adult Winter Sun.

name: destination
description: Destination country, island, or resort town.

name: ship_or_resort_name
description: Clean canonical cruise ship and/or hotel resort name.

name: departure_airport_or_port
description: UK departure airport or cruise port.

name: room_or_cabin_highlights
description: Detailed room/cabin attributes (interconnecting doors, soft sand, splash park, cabin deck, lift proximity, doorway width).

name: veteran_tribal_tip
description: 20-year veteran consultant insider tip (e.g., stony vs soft-sand beaches in Marbella vs Torremolinos, lifeboat obstructions on Arvia Deck 8).

name: standard_supplier_name
description: Standard 3rd-party tour operator (TUI, Jet2holidays, easyJet Holidays, P&O Direct).

name: standard_supplier_price_gbp
description: 3rd-party supplier total package price in GBP (£).

name: standard_commission_gbp
description: Branch commission earned on the 3rd-party supplier package (~10.5%) in GBP (£).

name: vista_inhouse_price_gbp
description: Hays Travel in-house Vista package price in GBP (£) — typically £130-£150 cheaper for the customer.

name: vista_branch_commission_gbp
description: Branch commission earned on the in-house Vista package (~21.5%) in GBP (£).

name: extra_branch_commission_gbp
description: Extra commission in GBP (£) earned by the branch when choosing Vista over the 3rd-party supplier (+£678.07 on B629C).

name: recommended_add_ons
description: Recommended Holiday Extras (airport parking, lounge) and Sunny Spend FX card load.
